networkTimingNote: Recorded 36-direction observations and shared-bearing caches make collection times unequal. Compare logical output budget and identical-cache offline timings, not collection wall-clock speed.
validationLimit: 72 fixed points, 3 locations, already inspected during development. No new independent blind-test or general spatial accuracy claim.
